import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from .inference import ROOT, infer
from .registry import (
    RegistryError,
    enable_model,
    list_models,
    register_model,
    revoke_model,
)
from .zk import ZkError, run_prove, run_setup, run_verify


def _parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Equipment-quality inference example")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    command = sub.add_parser("infer", help="Evaluate one JSON feature vector")
    command.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path)

    sub.add_parser("demo", help="Evaluate the bundled synthetic samples")

    setup = sub.add_parser("zk-setup", help="Compile the circuit and generate SRS and keys")
    setup.add_argument("--model", required=True, type=Path, help="ONNX model file")
    setup.add_argument("--dir", required=True, type=Path, help="Setup output directory")

    prove = sub.add_parser("zk-prove", help="Prove a private feature vector with EZKL (CPU)")
    prove.add_argument("--input", required=True, type=Path, help="JSON input containing features")
    prove.add_argument("--model", required=True, type=Path, help="ONNX model used at setup")
    prove.add_argument("--setup-dir", required=True, type=Path, help="Directory from zk-setup")
    prove.add_argument("--credential", required=True, type=Path, help="Credential JSON to write")

    verify = sub.add_parser(
        "zk-verify",
        help="Verify a credential against an enabled registry record and verifier-owned manifest; "
             "no input, proving key or network")
    verify.add_argument("--credential", required=True, type=Path)
    verify.add_argument(
        "--registry", required=True, type=Path,
        help="verifier-owned local model registry JSON; only enabled versions are admitted")
    verify.add_argument(
        "--model-version", required=True,
        help="registry version ([A-Za-z0-9._-]+) the credential is verified against")
    verify.add_argument(
        "--manifest", required=True, type=Path,
        help="manifest.json from a zk-setup run the verifier independently obtained and trusts")
    verify.add_argument("--model", required=True, type=Path, help="Verifier-chosen ONNX model")
    verify.add_argument("--settings", required=True, type=Path)
    verify.add_argument("--vk", required=True, type=Path, help="Verification key")
    verify.add_argument("--srs", required=True, type=Path)

    registry = sub.add_parser(
        "model-registry",
        help="Manage the local offline model registry (register/list/enable/revoke)")
    registry_sub = registry.add_subparsers(dest="registry_command", required=True)

    register = registry_sub.add_parser(
        "register", help="Register an approved manifest/model version (starts disabled)")
    register.add_argument("--registry", required=True, type=Path, help="Registry JSON file")
    register.add_argument(
        "--version", required=True,
        help="Model version token matching [A-Za-z0-9._-]+")
    register.add_argument("--manifest", required=True, type=Path, help="Approved setup manifest")
    register.add_argument("--model", required=True, type=Path, help="Approved ONNX model")

    list_cmd = registry_sub.add_parser(
        "list", help="List registered versions in lexicographic order")
    list_cmd.add_argument("--registry", required=True, type=Path, help="Registry JSON file")

    enable = registry_sub.add_parser("enable", help="Enable a disabled version")
    enable.add_argument("--registry", required=True, type=Path, help="Registry JSON file")
    enable.add_argument(
        "--version", required=True,
        help="Model version token matching [A-Za-z0-9._-]+")

    revoke = registry_sub.add_parser("revoke", help="Irreversibly revoke a version")
    revoke.add_argument("--registry", required=True, type=Path, help="Registry JSON file")
    revoke.add_argument(
        "--version", required=True,
        help="Model version token matching [A-Za-z0-9._-]+")
    return parser


def main():
    args = _parser().parse_args()
    try:
        if args.command == "infer":
            result = infer(json.loads(args.input.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        elif args.command == "demo":
            result = {name: infer(json.loads((ROOT / "samples" / f"{name}.json").read_text()))
                      for name in ("normal", "inspect")}
        elif args.command == "zk-setup":
            result = run_setup(args.model, args.dir)
        elif args.command == "zk-prove":
            result = run_prove(args.input, args.model, args.setup_dir, args.credential)
        elif args.command == "model-registry":
            if args.registry_command == "register":
                result = register_model(args.registry, args.version,
                                        args.manifest, args.model)
            elif args.registry_command == "list":
                result = {"models": list_models(args.registry)}
            elif args.registry_command == "enable":
                result = enable_model(args.registry, args.version)
            else:
                result = revoke_model(args.registry, args.version)
        else:
            result = run_verify(args.credential, args.manifest, args.model,
                               args.settings, args.vk, args.srs,
                               args.registry, args.model_version)
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, indent=2))
    except (ZkError, RegistryError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except (ValueError, OSError, RuntimeError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

1	"""Local, fully offline model registry for zk-quality models.
2	
3	The registry is a single verifier-owned JSON file mapping caller-chosen model
4	versions to the pinned facts of a ``zk-setup`` run the caller approves:
5	
6	* SHA-256 of the ONNX model and of the setup ``manifest.json``;
7	* the exact EZKL version and circuit ``output_scale``;
8	* SHA-256 digests of the settings, verification key and SRS.
9	
10	A newly registered version starts ``disabled`` and must be explicitly
11	``enable``d before ``zk-verify`` will admit it. ``revoke`` is irreversible: a
12	revoked version can never be enabled or overwritten. Registering the same
13	version with the same content is a no-op (idempotent); any content conflict is
14	rejected and never overwrites the existing record.
15	
16	The registry file is treated as hostile input on every load: JSON syntax,
17	duplicate keys, the envelope, every version key and every record field are
18	strictly validated. A missing, corrupt or structurally illegal registry is
19	rejected and is never rewritten, so a failed update always leaves the previous
20	file byte-for-byte intact. All successful updates are atomic (temp file plus
21	``os.replace``).
22	"""
23	import contextlib
24	import hashlib
25	import json
26	import os
27	import re
28	import tempfile
29	from pathlib import Path
30	
31	FORMAT_VERSION = 1
32	REGISTRY_KIND = "model-registry"
33	VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+")
34	EZKL_VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+")
35	STATUS_DISABLED = "disabled"
36	STATUS_ENABLED = "enabled"
37	STATUS_REVOKED = "revoked"
38	STATUSES = (STATUS_DISABLED, STATUS_ENABLED, STATUS_REVOKED)
39	# Verification parameters pinned per version; the compiled circuit and proving
40	# key never enter the registry because verifiers never hold them.
41	PINNED_ARTIFACTS = ("settings", "vk", "srs")
42	
43	_HEX64 = set("0123456789abcdef")
44	
45	
46	class RegistryError(Exception):
47	    """Raised for any missing, corrupt, conflicting or illegal registry use."""
48	
49	
50	def _sha256(path):
51	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
52	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
53	        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1 << 20), b""):
54	            digest.update(chunk)
55	    return digest.hexdigest()
56	
57	
58	def _is_sha256_hex(value):
59	    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 and all(char in _HEX64 for char in value)
60	
61	
62	def validate_version(version):
63	    """A version is a non-empty ``[A-Za-z0-9._-]+`` token; nothing else."""
64	    if not isinstance(version, str) or not VERSION_RE.fullmatch(version):
65	        raise RegistryError(
66	            "model version must be a non-empty token matching [A-Za-z0-9._-]+")
67	    return version
68	
69	
70	def _reject_duplicate_keys(pairs):
71	    document = {}
72	    for key, value in pairs:
73	        if key in document:
74	            raise RegistryError(f"registry JSON contains a duplicate key: {key!r}")
75	        document[key] = value
76	    return document
77	
78	
79	def _validate_document(document):
80	    if not isinstance(document, dict):
81	        raise RegistryError("registry must be a JSON object")
82	    if set(document) != {"format_version", "kind", "models"}:
83	        raise RegistryError("registry has missing or unexpected top-level fields")
84	    if document["format_version"] != FORMAT_VERSION:
85	        raise RegistryError("registry format version is unsupported")
86	    if document["kind"] != REGISTRY_KIND:
87	        raise RegistryError("registry file is not a model registry")
88	    models = document["models"]
89	    if not isinstance(models, dict):
90	        raise RegistryError("registry 'models' must be a JSON object")
91	
92	    for version, record in models.items():
93	        validate_version(version)
94	        if not isinstance(record, dict):
95	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} must be an object")
96	        if set(record) != {"status", "model_sha256", "manifest_sha256", "ezkl_version",
97	                           "output_scale", "artifacts"}:
98	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has missing or extra fields")
99	        if record["status"] not in STATUSES:
100	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid status")
101	        if not _is_sha256_hex(record["model_sha256"]):
102	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid model digest")
103	        if not _is_sha256_hex(record["manifest_sha256"]):
104	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid manifest digest")
105	        ezkl_version = record["ezkl_version"]
106	        if not isinstance(ezkl_version, str) or not EZKL_VERSION_RE.fullmatch(ezkl_version):
107	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid EZKL version")
108	        scale = record["output_scale"]
109	        if not isinstance(scale, int) or isinstance(scale, bool) or scale <= 0:
110	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid output scale")
111	        artifacts = record["artifacts"]
112	        if not isinstance(artifacts, dict) or set(artifacts) != set(PINNED_ARTIFACTS):
113	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has invalid artifact digests")
114	        if any(not _is_sha256_hex(artifacts[key]) for key in PINNED_ARTIFACTS):
115	            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid artifact digest")
116	
117	
118	def _empty_document():
119	    return {"format_version": FORMAT_VERSION, "kind": REGISTRY_KIND, "models": {}}
120	
121	
122	def load_registry(registry_path):
123	    """Load and strictly validate a registry that must already exist."""
124	    registry_path = Path(registry_path)
125	    if registry_path.is_dir():
126	        raise RegistryError(f"registry path is a directory, not a file: {registry_path}")
127	    if not registry_path.is_file():
128	        raise RegistryError(f"model registry not found: {registry_path}")
129	    try:
130	        raw = registry_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
131	        document = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_keys,
132	                              parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
133	                                  RegistryError(f"invalid JSON constant {value}")))
134	    except OSError as error:
135	        raise RegistryError(f"cannot read model registry: {error}") from error
136	    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
137	        raise RegistryError(f"model registry is not valid JSON: {error}") from error
138	    _validate_document(document)
139	    return document
140	
141	
142	def _atomic_write(registry_path, document):
143	    """Validate, then publish the document via a same-directory temp file."""
144	    _validate_document(document)
145	    registry_path = Path(registry_path)
146	    if registry_path.is_dir():
147	        raise RegistryError(f"registry path is a directory: {registry_path}")
148	    registry_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
149	    handle = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
150	        mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=registry_path.parent,
151	        prefix=".registry-", suffix=".tmp", delete=False)
152	    try:
153	        json.dump(document, handle, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False,
154	                  indent=2, sort_keys=True)
155	        handle.write("\n")
156	        handle.flush()
157	        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
158	        handle.close()
159	        os.replace(handle.name, registry_path)
160	    except BaseException:
161	        handle.close()
162	        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
163	            os.unlink(handle.name)
164	        raise
165	
166	
167	def _record_from_manifest(manifest, manifest_sha):
168	    return {
169	        "status": STATUS_DISABLED,
170	        "model_sha256": manifest["model_sha256"],
171	        "manifest_sha256": manifest_sha,
172	        "ezkl_version": manifest["ezkl_version"],
173	        "output_scale": int(manifest["output_scale"]),
174	        "artifacts": {key: manifest["artifacts"][key] for key in PINNED_ARTIFACTS},
175	    }
176	
177	
178	def register_model(registry_path, version, manifest_path, model_path):
179	    """Register an approved manifest/ONNX pair under ``version``.
180	
181	    The setup manifest is fully re-validated (including the installed EZKL
182	    version) and the ONNX file must hash to the model digest it pins. A new
183	    version is stored as ``disabled``. Re-registering the identical record is
184	    a no-op and leaves the current status untouched; any differing content for
185	    an existing version is a conflict and is rejected without writing.
186	    """
187	    version = validate_version(version)
188	    manifest_path = Path(manifest_path)
189	    model_path = Path(model_path)
190	    if not manifest_path.is_file():
191	        raise RegistryError(f"setup manifest not found: {manifest_path}")
192	    if not model_path.is_file():
193	        raise RegistryError(f"ONNX model not found: {model_path}")
194	
195	    # Imported lazily: zk.py imports this module, so a module-level import
196	    # would be circular.
197	    from .zk import ZkError, _read_manifest
198	
199	    try:
200	        manifest = _read_manifest(manifest_path)
201	    except ZkError as error:
202	        raise RegistryError(f"cannot register an untrusted manifest: {error}") from error
203	    model_sha = _sha256(model_path)
204	    if model_sha != manifest["model_sha256"]:
205	        raise RegistryError(
206	            "ONNX model does not match the model digest pinned in the manifest; "
207	            "register only a model/manifest pair you approve")
208	    manifest_sha = _sha256(manifest_path)
209	    candidate = _record_from_manifest(manifest, manifest_sha)
210	
211	    registry_path = Path(registry_path)
212	    if registry_path.exists():
213	        document = load_registry(registry_path)
214	        existing = document["models"].get(version)
215	        if existing is not None:
216	            # Identity is content, not status: the lifecycle state must never
217	            # be resettable by re-registering (a revoked version stays revoked).
218	            if {key: value for key, value in existing.items() if key != "status"} != \
219	                    {key: value for key, value in candidate.items() if key != "status"}:
220	                raise RegistryError(
221	                    f"model version {version!r} already exists with different content; "
222	                    "refusing to overwrite. Revoke it or register under a new version")
223	            return {"version": version, "status": existing["status"], "changed": False}
224	    else:
225	        document = _empty_document()
226	
227	    document["models"][version] = candidate
228	    _atomic_write(registry_path, document)
229	    return {"version": version, "status": STATUS_DISABLED, "changed": True}
230	
231	
232	def list_models(registry_path):
233	    """Return all records ordered by version in lexicographic order."""
234	    document = load_registry(registry_path)
235	    return [dict(version=version, **document["models"][version])
236	            for version in sorted(document["models"])]
237	
238	
239	def _set_status(registry_path, version, target, *, allowed_from, idempotent):
240	    version = validate_version(version)
241	    document = load_registry(registry_path)
242	    record = document["models"].get(version)
243	    if record is None:
244	        raise RegistryError(f"model version is not registered: {version!r}")
245	    if record["status"] == target and idempotent:
246	        return {"version": version, "status": target, "changed": False}
247	    if record["status"] not in allowed_from:
248	        raise RegistryError(
249	            f"model version {version!r} is {record['status']} and cannot be {target}")
250	    record["status"] = target
251	    _atomic_write(registry_path, document)
252	    return {"version": version, "status": target, "changed": True}
253	
254	
255	def enable_model(registry_path, version):
256	    """Enable a ``disabled`` version. Enabled stays enabled; revoked is final."""
257	    return _set_status(registry_path, version, STATUS_ENABLED,
258	                       allowed_from=(STATUS_DISABLED,), idempotent=True)
259	
260	
261	def revoke_model(registry_path, version):
262	    """Irreversibly revoke a registered version; revoking again is a no-op."""
263	    return _set_status(registry_path, version, STATUS_REVOKED,
264	                       allowed_from=(STATUS_DISABLED, STATUS_ENABLED), idempotent=True)
265	
266	
267	def admit_version(registry_path, version):
268	    """Return the record for ``version`` only if it is registered and enabled.
269	
270	    This is the registry gate that runs before any cryptographic verification:
271	    a corrupt registry, an unknown version, or a disabled/revoked version are
272	    all refused and nothing about a credential can change that decision.
273	    """
274	    version = validate_version(version)
275	    document = load_registry(registry_path)
276	    record = document["models"].get(version)
277	    if record is None:
278	        raise RegistryError(f"model version is not registered: {version!r}")
279	    if record["status"] != STATUS_ENABLED:
280	        raise RegistryError(
281	            f"model version {version!r} is {record['status']}; "
282	            f"only {STATUS_ENABLED!r} versions can be verified")
283	    return record

"""Local, fully offline model registry for zk-quality models.

The registry is a single verifier-owned JSON file mapping caller-chosen model
versions to the pinned facts of a ``zk-setup`` run the caller approves:

* SHA-256 of the ONNX model and of the setup ``manifest.json``;
* the exact EZKL version and circuit ``output_scale``;
* SHA-256 digests of the settings, verification key and SRS.

A newly registered version starts ``disabled`` and must be explicitly
``enable``d before ``zk-verify`` will admit it. ``revoke`` is irreversible: a
revoked version can never be enabled or overwritten. Registering the same
version with the same content is a no-op (idempotent); any content conflict is
rejected and never overwrites the existing record.

The registry file is treated as hostile input on every load: JSON syntax,
duplicate keys, the envelope, every version key and every record field are
strictly validated. A missing, corrupt or structurally illegal registry is
rejected and is never rewritten, so a failed update always leaves the previous
file byte-for-byte intact. All successful updates are atomic (temp file plus
``os.replace``).
"""
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

FORMAT_VERSION = 1
REGISTRY_KIND = "model-registry"
VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+")
EZKL_VERSION_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+")
STATUS_DISABLED = "disabled"
STATUS_ENABLED = "enabled"
STATUS_REVOKED = "revoked"
STATUSES = (STATUS_DISABLED, STATUS_ENABLED, STATUS_REVOKED)
# Verification parameters pinned per version; the compiled circuit and proving
# key never enter the registry because verifiers never hold them.
PINNED_ARTIFACTS = ("settings", "vk", "srs")

_HEX64 = set("0123456789abcdef")


class RegistryError(Exception):
    """Raised for any missing, corrupt, conflicting or illegal registry use."""


def _sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _is_sha256_hex(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 64 and all(char in _HEX64 for char in value)


def validate_version(version):
    """A version is a non-empty ``[A-Za-z0-9._-]+`` token; nothing else."""
    if not isinstance(version, str) or not VERSION_RE.fullmatch(version):
        raise RegistryError(
            "model version must be a non-empty token matching [A-Za-z0-9._-]+")
    return version


def _reject_duplicate_keys(pairs):
    document = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in document:
            raise RegistryError(f"registry JSON contains a duplicate key: {key!r}")
        document[key] = value
    return document


def _validate_document(document):
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise RegistryError("registry must be a JSON object")
    if set(document) != {"format_version", "kind", "models"}:
        raise RegistryError("registry has missing or unexpected top-level fields")
    if document["format_version"] != FORMAT_VERSION:
        raise RegistryError("registry format version is unsupported")
    if document["kind"] != REGISTRY_KIND:
        raise RegistryError("registry file is not a model registry")
    models = document["models"]
    if not isinstance(models, dict):
        raise RegistryError("registry 'models' must be a JSON object")

    for version, record in models.items():
        validate_version(version)
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} must be an object")
        if set(record) != {"status", "model_sha256", "manifest_sha256", "ezkl_version",
                           "output_scale", "artifacts"}:
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has missing or extra fields")
        if record["status"] not in STATUSES:
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid status")
        if not _is_sha256_hex(record["model_sha256"]):
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid model digest")
        if not _is_sha256_hex(record["manifest_sha256"]):
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid manifest digest")
        ezkl_version = record["ezkl_version"]
        if not isinstance(ezkl_version, str) or not EZKL_VERSION_RE.fullmatch(ezkl_version):
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid EZKL version")
        scale = record["output_scale"]
        if not isinstance(scale, int) or isinstance(scale, bool) or scale <= 0:
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid output scale")
        artifacts = record["artifacts"]
        if not isinstance(artifacts, dict) or set(artifacts) != set(PINNED_ARTIFACTS):
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has invalid artifact digests")
        if any(not _is_sha256_hex(artifacts[key]) for key in PINNED_ARTIFACTS):
            raise RegistryError(f"registry record for {version!r} has an invalid artifact digest")


def _empty_document():
    return {"format_version": FORMAT_VERSION, "kind": REGISTRY_KIND, "models": {}}


def load_registry(registry_path):
    """Load and strictly validate a registry that must already exist."""
    registry_path = Path(registry_path)
    if registry_path.is_dir():
        raise RegistryError(f"registry path is a directory, not a file: {registry_path}")
    if not registry_path.is_file():
        raise RegistryError(f"model registry not found: {registry_path}")
    try:
        raw = registry_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        document = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_keys,
                              parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
                                  RegistryError(f"invalid JSON constant {value}")))
    except OSError as error:
        raise RegistryError(f"cannot read model registry: {error}") from error
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        raise RegistryError(f"model registry is not valid JSON: {error}") from error
    _validate_document(document)
    return document


def _atomic_write(registry_path, document):
    """Validate, then publish the document via a same-directory temp file."""
    _validate_document(document)
    registry_path = Path(registry_path)
    if registry_path.is_dir():
        raise RegistryError(f"registry path is a directory: {registry_path}")
    registry_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    handle = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
        mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=registry_path.parent,
        prefix=".registry-", suffix=".tmp", delete=False)
    try:
        json.dump(document, handle, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False,
                  indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        handle.write("\n")
        handle.flush()
        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        handle.close()
        os.replace(handle.name, registry_path)
    except BaseException:
        handle.close()
        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
            os.unlink(handle.name)
        raise


def _record_from_manifest(manifest, manifest_sha):
    return {
        "status": STATUS_DISABLED,
        "model_sha256": manifest["model_sha256"],
        "manifest_sha256": manifest_sha,
        "ezkl_version": manifest["ezkl_version"],
        "output_scale": int(manifest["output_scale"]),
        "artifacts": {key: manifest["artifacts"][key] for key in PINNED_ARTIFACTS},
    }


def register_model(registry_path, version, manifest_path, model_path):
    """Register an approved manifest/ONNX pair under ``version``.

    The setup manifest is fully re-validated (including the installed EZKL
    version) and the ONNX file must hash to the model digest it pins. A new
    version is stored as ``disabled``. Re-registering the identical record is
    a no-op and leaves the current status untouched; any differing content for
    an existing version is a conflict and is rejected without writing.
    """
    version = validate_version(version)
    manifest_path = Path(manifest_path)
    model_path = Path(model_path)
    if not manifest_path.is_file():
        raise RegistryError(f"setup manifest not found: {manifest_path}")
    if not model_path.is_file():
        raise RegistryError(f"ONNX model not found: {model_path}")

    # Imported lazily: zk.py imports this module, so a module-level import
    # would be circular.
    from .zk import ZkError, _read_manifest

    try:
        manifest = _read_manifest(manifest_path)
    except ZkError as error:
        raise RegistryError(f"cannot register an untrusted manifest: {error}") from error
    model_sha = _sha256(model_path)
    if model_sha != manifest["model_sha256"]:
        raise RegistryError(
            "ONNX model does not match the model digest pinned in the manifest; "
            "register only a model/manifest pair you approve")
    manifest_sha = _sha256(manifest_path)
    candidate = _record_from_manifest(manifest, manifest_sha)

    registry_path = Path(registry_path)
    if registry_path.exists():
        document = load_registry(registry_path)
        existing = document["models"].get(version)
        if existing is not None:
            # Identity is content, not status: the lifecycle state must never
            # be resettable by re-registering (a revoked version stays revoked).
            if {key: value for key, value in existing.items() if key != "status"} != \
                    {key: value for key, value in candidate.items() if key != "status"}:
                raise RegistryError(
                    f"model version {version!r} already exists with different content; "
                    "refusing to overwrite. Revoke it or register under a new version")
            return {"version": version, "status": existing["status"], "changed": False}
    else:
        document = _empty_document()

    document["models"][version] = candidate
    _atomic_write(registry_path, document)
    return {"version": version, "status": STATUS_DISABLED, "changed": True}


def list_models(registry_path):
    """Return all records ordered by version in lexicographic order."""
    document = load_registry(registry_path)
    return [dict(version=version, **document["models"][version])
            for version in sorted(document["models"])]


def _set_status(registry_path, version, target, *, allowed_from, idempotent):
    version = validate_version(version)
    document = load_registry(registry_path)
    record = document["models"].get(version)
    if record is None:
        raise RegistryError(f"model version is not registered: {version!r}")
    if record["status"] == target and idempotent:
        return {"version": version, "status": target, "changed": False}
    if record["status"] not in allowed_from:
        raise RegistryError(
            f"model version {version!r} is {record['status']} and cannot be {target}")
    record["status"] = target
    _atomic_write(registry_path, document)
    return {"version": version, "status": target, "changed": True}


def enable_model(registry_path, version):
    """Enable a ``disabled`` version. Enabled stays enabled; revoked is final."""
    return _set_status(registry_path, version, STATUS_ENABLED,
                       allowed_from=(STATUS_DISABLED,), idempotent=True)


def revoke_model(registry_path, version):
    """Irreversibly revoke a registered version; revoking again is a no-op."""
    return _set_status(registry_path, version, STATUS_REVOKED,
                       allowed_from=(STATUS_DISABLED, STATUS_ENABLED), idempotent=True)


def admit_version(registry_path, version):
    """Return the record for ``version`` only if it is registered and enabled.

    This is the registry gate that runs before any cryptographic verification:
    a corrupt registry, an unknown version, or a disabled/revoked version are
    all refused and nothing about a credential can change that decision.
    """
    version = validate_version(version)
    document = load_registry(registry_path)
    record = document["models"].get(version)
    if record is None:
        raise RegistryError(f"model version is not registered: {version!r}")
    if record["status"] != STATUS_ENABLED:
        raise RegistryError(
            f"model version {version!r} is {record['status']}; "
            f"only {STATUS_ENABLED!r} versions can be verified")
    return record


def require_record_matches(record, *, manifest_sha, manifest):
    """Bind an admitted registry record to the verifier's trusted manifest.

    The registry is verifier-owned but is still compared field by field
    against the manifest root of trust: model and manifest digest, EZKL
    version, output scale, and settings/VK/SRS digests must all agree. The
    on-disk files were already hashed against the manifest by
    ``load_verifier_materials``, so a mismatched record — like a forged
    credential — can never steer verification onto other material.
    """
    if record["manifest_sha256"] != manifest_sha:
        raise RegistryError(
            "registry record does not match the verifier manifest: manifest digest differs")
    comparisons = (
        ("model_sha256", record["model_sha256"], manifest["model_sha256"], "model"),
        ("ezkl_version", record["ezkl_version"], manifest["ezkl_version"], "EZKL version"),
        ("output_scale", int(record["output_scale"]), int(manifest["output_scale"]),
         "output scale"),
    )
    for field, actual, expected, label in comparisons:
        if actual != expected:
            raise RegistryError(
                f"registry record does not match the verifier manifest: {label} differs")
    for key in PINNED_ARTIFACTS:
        if record["artifacts"][key] != manifest["artifacts"][key]:
            raise RegistryError(
                f"registry record does not match the verifier manifest: {key} digest differs")

1	"""Real EZKL 23.0.5 CPU zero-knowledge proof loop for the quality model.
2	
3	Three stages:
4	
5	* ``run_setup`` compiles an ONNX model into a circuit and produces settings,
6	  proving key, verification key and SRS (offline, CPU), together with a
7	  ``manifest.json`` that pins every public artifact by SHA-256.
8	* ``run_prove`` consumes a private six-feature input, generates the witness and
9	  a real proof, and writes a self-contained JSON credential. Only the two
10	  quantized output scores are public; the features stay private.
11	* ``run_verify`` checks a credential against public materials the verifier
12	  independently obtained: the setup manifest plus the ONNX model, settings,
13	  VK and SRS named by it. It needs neither the original input nor the proving
14	  key nor the compiled circuit nor any network access.
15	
16	Trust model: the verifier's own ``manifest.json`` (obtained through a channel
17	the verifier trusts, e.g. produced by their own ``zk-setup`` run) is the single
18	root of trust. It pins the format version, credential/setup kind, EZKL version,
19	the model digest and the digests of settings, the verification key and the SRS;
20	the manifest in turn binds the circuit, because the VK only validates proofs
21	for the circuit/settings it was generated for. Nothing embedded in the
22	credential is ever treated as authoritative: its digests and parameters are at
23	most cross-checked against the manifest and, ultimately, against EZKL.
24	
25	The ordinary ONNX floating-point scores are never presented as proven values:
26	the credential only carries the quantized scores that are the circuit's public
27	instances.
28	"""
29	import contextlib
30	import hashlib
31	import importlib.metadata
32	import json
33	import os
34	import tempfile
35	from pathlib import Path
36	
37	import ezkl
38	
39	from .inference import validate_features
40	from .registry import RegistryError, admit_version, require_record_matches
41	
42	FORMAT_VERSION = 1
43	CREDENTIAL_KIND = "zk-quality-credential"
44	SETUP_KIND = "zk-quality-setup"
45	ARTIFACT_NAMES = {
46	    "compiled": "compiled.ezkl",
47	    "settings": "settings.json",
48	    "pk": "proving.key",
49	    "vk": "verification.key",
50	    "srs": "srs",
51	}
52	# Public verification materials whose digests the manifest pins and that the
53	# verifier must hold. The compiled circuit and proving key stay with the prover.
54	VERIFICATION_ARTIFACTS = ("settings", "vk", "srs")
55	MANIFEST_NAME = "manifest.json"
56	
57	# Labels follow the existing inference convention: index 0 is "normal",
58	# index 1 is "inspect", and a tie resolves to "normal".
59	LABELS = ("normal", "inspect")

65	    """Raised for any invalid input, artifact mismatch or EZKL failure."""

69	    try:

99	    is still surfaced on failure.

120	def _calibration_rows():

124	    over the six-dimensional [0, 1] input cube occur at the 2**6 binary
125	    vertices. The two bundled sample vectors are added for good measure.

127	    rows = [[float((i >> bit) & 1) for bit in range(6)] for i in range(1 << 6)]

178	            if output_scale <= 0 or not 1 <= logrows <= 30:

194	            # are about to publish so setup can never emit a broken manifest.
195	            artifact_digests = {key: _sha256(target) for key, target in targets.items()}
196	            manifest = {
197	                "format_version": FORMAT_VERSION,
198	                "kind": SETUP_KIND,
199	                "ezkl_version": ezkl_version(),
200	                "model_sha256": model_sha,
201	                "logrows": logrows,
202	                "output_scale": output_scale,
203	                "artifacts": artifact_digests,
204	            }
205	            _validate_manifest_fields(manifest)
206	            manifest_part = setup_dir / f".{MANIFEST_NAME}.part"
207	            manifest_part.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
208	            partials.append(manifest_part)
209	            os.replace(manifest_part, setup_dir / MANIFEST_NAME)
210	            partials.append(setup_dir / MANIFEST_NAME)
211	            partials = []
212	    except Exception:
213	        for leftover in partials:
214	            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):

222	def _validate_manifest_fields(manifest):
223	    """Shape and field validation shared by the producer and every consumer.
224	
225	    Every digest must be 64 lowercase hex characters; missing or malformed
226	    fields are rejected rather than coerced.
227	    """
228	    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
229	        raise ZkError("setup manifest must be a JSON object")
230	    if manifest.get("format_version") != FORMAT_VERSION:
231	        raise ZkError("setup manifest format version is unsupported")
232	    if manifest.get("kind") != SETUP_KIND:
233	        raise ZkError("setup manifest is unsupported or was not produced by zk-setup")
234	    if manifest.get("ezkl_version") != ezkl_version():
235	        raise ZkError(
236	            f"setup was produced with EZKL {manifest.get('ezkl_version')}, "
237	            f"installed EZKL is {ezkl_version()}")
238	    if not _is_sha256_hex(manifest.get("model_sha256")):
239	        raise ZkError("setup manifest records an invalid model SHA-256")
240	    if not isinstance(manifest.get("logrows"), int) or isinstance(manifest.get("logrows"), bool) \

245	        raise ZkError("setup manifest records an invalid output scale")
246	    digests = manifest.get("artifacts")

258	    manifest_path = _require_file(manifest_path, "setup manifest")
259	    try:

261	                              parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(

270	    """Resolve the verifier's trust material against its own manifest.
271

273	    artifact must hash to the digest pinned in it. Returns the validated
274	    manifest, material paths and the output scale. Nothing here consults a
275	    credential.
276	    """
277	    manifest = _read_manifest(manifest_path)
278	    supplied = {
279	        "settings": (settings_path, "settings file"),
280	        "vk": (vk_path, "verification key"),

290	    for key, (path, expected_digest) in materials.items():
291	        actual_digest = _sha256(path)

293	            label = "ONNX model" if key == "model" else ARTIFACT_NAMES[key]

300	        "model_sha256": manifest["model_sha256"],

310	def _check_artifacts(manifest, paths):
311	    """Verify every setup artifact on disk still matches the setup manifest."""
312	    digests = manifest["artifacts"]
313	    for key in paths:
314	        if _sha256(paths[key]) != digests[key]:

320	def _decode_instances(instances, scale):
321	    if not isinstance(instances, list) or len(instances) != 1 or not isinstance(instances[0], list):
322	        raise ZkError("proof does not expose exactly one public output row")
323	    row = instances[0]
324	    if len(row) != 2 or not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in row):
325	        raise ZkError("proof must expose exactly two public quantized scores")
326	    scores = []
327	    for felt in row:
328	        try:
329	            scores.append(int(ezkl.felt_to_int(felt)))
330	        except (TypeError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
331	            raise ZkError(f"public score '{felt}' is not a valid field element: {error}") from error
332	    if not all(-(1 << 31) < score < (1 << 31) for score in scores):
333	        raise ZkError("public quantized scores fall outside the plausible range")
334	    label = LABELS[0] if scores[0] >= scores[1] else LABELS[1]
335	    fixed_point = [score / (1 << scale) for score in scores]
336	    return scores, fixed_point, label

342	        proof_doc = json.loads(raw)
343	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:

345	    if not isinstance(proof_doc, dict) or not isinstance(proof_doc.get("instances"), list):

350	def run_prove(input_path, model, setup_dir, credential_path):
351	    """Generate witness and a real proof for one private feature vector."""
352	    input_path = _require_file(input_path, "input file")
353	    model = _require_file(model, "ONNX model")
354	    setup_dir = Path(setup_dir)
355	    if not setup_dir.is_dir():
356	        raise ZkError(f"setup directory not found: {setup_dir}")
357	    credential_path = Path(credential_path)
358	    if credential_path.is_dir():
359	        raise ZkError(f"credential path is a directory: {credential_path}")
360	    if not credential_path.resolve().parent.is_dir():
361	        raise ZkError(f"credential output directory does not exist: {credential_path.parent}")
362	
363	    try:
364	        document = json.loads(input_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
365	                              parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
366	                                  ValueError(f"invalid JSON constant {value}")))
367	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as error:
368	        raise ZkError(f"invalid input JSON ({input_path}): {error}") from error
369	    try:
370	        features = validate_features(document)  # identical six-dimension contract as `infer`
371	    except ValueError as error:

373	
374	    manifest = _read_manifest(setup_dir / MANIFEST_NAME)
375	    model_sha = _sha256(model)
376	    if model_sha != manifest["model_sha256"]:
377	        raise ZkError("model does not match the model this setup was built for")
378	    paths = _artifact_paths(setup_dir)
379	    _check_artifacts(manifest, paths)
380	    scale = int(manifest["output_scale"])

382	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="zkprove-") as scratch:
383	        scratch = Path(scratch)
384	        ezkl_input = scratch / "witness-input.json"
385	        witness_path = scratch / "witness.json"
386	        proof_path = scratch / "proof.pf"
387	        ezkl_input.write_text(json.dumps({"input_data": [features]}), encoding="utf-8")
388	        with _quiet_stderr():
389	            witness = ezkl.gen_witness(
390	                str(ezkl_input), str(paths["compiled"]), str(witness_path), None, None)
391	            if not isinstance(witness, dict) or "outputs" not in witness:
392	                raise ZkError("witness generation produced no public outputs")
393	            proof_result = ezkl.prove(str(witness_path), str(paths["compiled"]),
394	                                      str(paths["pk"]), str(proof_path), str(paths["srs"]))
395	            if not proof_path.is_file() or not isinstance(proof_result, dict):
396	                raise ZkError("proving did not produce a proof")
397	            # Self-check before issuing a credential; requires local artifacts only.
398	            if ezkl.verify(str(proof_path), str(paths["settings"]), str(paths["vk"]),
399	                           str(paths["srs"]), False) is not True:
400	                raise ZkError("freshly generated proof failed local verification")
401	
402	        proof_doc = _read_proof_document(proof_path)
403	        scores, fixed_point, label = _decode_instances(proof_doc["instances"], scale)
404	
405	        # The witness also reports the decoded outputs; they must agree with the
406	        # public instances that actually went into the proof.
407	        witness_scores, _, witness_label = _decode_instances(witness["outputs"], scale)
408	        if witness_scores != scores or witness_label != label:

411	    credential = {

413	        "kind": CREDENTIAL_KIND,
414	        "ezkl_version": ezkl_version(),
415	        "model_sha256": model_sha,
416	        "verification_artifacts": {
417	            "settings_sha256": _sha256(paths["settings"]),
418	            "vk_sha256": _sha256(paths["vk"]),
419	            "srs_sha256": _sha256(paths["srs"]),
420	        },
421	        "public_output": {
422	            "output_scale": scale,
423	            "quantized_scores": scores,
424	            "scores_fixed_point": fixed_point,
425	            "label": label,

435	    credential_path = Path(credential_path)

437	        mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=credential_path.resolve().parent,

440	        json.dump(credential, handle, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))

446	        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):

451	def _load_credential(credential_path):
452	    credential_path = _require_file(credential_path, "credential")
453	    try:
454	        raw = Path(credential_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
455	        credential = json.loads(raw, parse_constant=lambda value: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
456	            ValueError(f"invalid JSON constant {value}")))
457	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as error:
458	        raise ZkError(f"invalid credential JSON: {error}") from error
459	    if not isinstance(credential, dict):

461	    if credential.get("kind") != CREDENTIAL_KIND or credential.get("format_version") != FORMAT_VERSION:

463	    for field in ("ezkl_version", "model_sha256", "verification_artifacts", "public_output", "proof"):
464	        if field not in credential:

466	    if credential["ezkl_version"] != ezkl_version():
467	        raise ZkError(
468	            f"credential was produced with EZKL {credential['ezkl_version']}, "
469	            f"verifier uses EZKL {ezkl_version()}")
470	    if not _is_sha256_hex(credential["model_sha256"]):
471	        raise ZkError("credential model digest is invalid")
472	    # A credential must never carry the private input.
473	    if "features" in credential or "input_data" in credential:
474	        raise ZkError("credential illegally contains private input data")
475	    artifacts = credential["verification_artifacts"]
476	    if not isinstance(artifacts, dict) or any(
477	            not _is_sha256_hex(artifacts.get(key))
478	            for key in ("settings_sha256", "vk_sha256", "srs_sha256")):
479	        raise ZkError("credential verification-artifact digests are invalid")
480	    public = credential["public_output"]
481	    if not isinstance(public, dict) or not isinstance(public.get("quantized_scores"), list) \
482	            or len(public["quantized_scores"]) != 2 \
483	            or not all(isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)
484	                       for v in public["quantized_scores"]) \
485	            or public.get("label") not in LABELS \
486	            or not isinstance(public.get("output_scale"), int) or public["output_scale"] <= 0:
487	        raise ZkError("credential public output is invalid")

489	                      for score in public["quantized_scores"]]
490	    if public.get("scores_fixed_point") != expected_fixed:
491	        raise ZkError("credential fixed-point scores do not match the quantized scores")

493	            or not isinstance(credential["proof"].get("instances"), list):
494	        raise ZkError("credential proof payload is invalid")
495	    return credential

498	def run_verify(credential_path, manifest_path, model, settings_path, vk_path, srs_path,
499	               registry_path, model_version):
500	    """Verify a credential offline against the verifier's own trust material.
501	
502	    Before any cryptographic check the verifier's local model registry must
503	    admit ``model_version`` (registered and ``enabled``) and the admitted
504	    record must agree, field by field, with the verifier's own trusted
505	    manifest: model and manifest SHA-256, EZKL version, output scale and the
506	    settings/VK/SRS digests. Unknown, disabled, revoked or mismatching
507	    versions, and a corrupt registry, are all refused.
508	
509	    The verifier's ``manifest.json`` — not the credential and not the registry
510	    record — stays the root of trust. The model digest and every
511	    settings/VK/SRS digest are recomputed from the verifier's files and matched
512	    to the manifest first; the matching files then drive EZKL cryptographic
513	    verification. Credential-embedded digests and parameters are never
514	    authoritative: they are merely required to agree with the manifest, and a
515	    proof for a different circuit/key cannot pass EZKL against the pinned VK
516	    and settings.
517	    """
518	    # Registry gate first: before hashing anything or touching the credential,
519	    # only an explicitly enabled version in a valid verifier-owned registry
520	    # may be verified at all. A missing/corrupt registry or an unknown,
521	    # disabled or revoked version stops verification here.
522	    record = admit_version(registry_path, model_version)
523	
524	    # Bind model, circuit (via the VK generated for it) and verification
525	    # parameters to the verifier's manifest, then compare the admitted record
526	    # against it field by field. Both consult only verifier-owned files;
527	    # nothing in the credential can affect either decision.
528	    materials = load_verifier_materials(
529	        manifest_path, model, settings_path, vk_path, srs_path)
530	    manifest = materials["manifest"]
531	    paths = materials["paths"]
532	    model_sha = materials["model_sha256"]
533	    scale = materials["output_scale"]
534	    require_record_matches(record, manifest_sha=_sha256(manifest_path), manifest=manifest)
535	
536	    credential = _load_credential(credential_path)
537	
538	    # Cross-checks against the manifest. These are defence in depth — the
539	    # credential values cannot weaken verification because EZKL is driven
540	    # solely by the manifest-pinned files — but a credential that claims a
541	    # different model or parameters is rejected outright rather than accepted
542	    # over a valid proof.
543	    if credential["model_sha256"] != model_sha:
544	        raise ZkError("credential model digest does not match the verifier manifest")
545	    claimed = credential["verification_artifacts"]
546	    expected_artifacts = {
547	        "settings_sha256": manifest["artifacts"]["settings"],
548	        "vk_sha256": manifest["artifacts"]["vk"],
549	        "srs_sha256": manifest["artifacts"]["srs"],
550	    }
551	    for key, expected_digest in expected_artifacts.items():
552	        if claimed[key] != expected_digest:
553	            raise ZkError(f"credential {key} does not match the verifier manifest")
554	    if credential["ezkl_version"] != manifest["ezkl_version"]:
555	        raise ZkError("credential EZKL version does not match the verifier manifest")
556	    if credential["public_output"]["output_scale"] != scale:
557	        raise ZkError("credential output scale does not match the verifier manifest")
558	
559	    # Independently confirm the pinned settings file really carries the scale
560	    # and EZKL version the manifest/credential describe.
561	    try:
562	        settings_doc = json.loads(paths["settings"].read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
563	        settings_scale = int(settings_doc["model_output_scales"][0])
564	        settings_version = str(settings_doc["version"])
565	    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
566	        raise ZkError(f"settings file is unreadable: {error}") from error
567	    if settings_version != manifest["ezkl_version"]:
568	        raise ZkError(
569	            f"settings were produced with EZKL {settings_version}, "
570	            f"manifest pins EZKL {manifest['ezkl_version']}")
571	    if settings_scale != scale:
572	        raise ZkError("settings output scale does not match the verifier manifest")
573	
574	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="zkverify-") as scratch:
575	        proof_path = Path(scratch) / "proof.pf"
576	        proof_path.write_text(json.dumps(credential["proof"]), encoding="utf-8")
577	        with _quiet_stderr():
578	            accepted = ezkl.verify(str(proof_path), str(paths["settings"]), str(paths["vk"]),
579	                                   str(paths["srs"]), False)
580	        if accepted is not True:
581	            raise ZkError("proof verification failed")
582	
583	    scores, fixed_point, label = _decode_instances(
584	        credential["proof"]["instances"], settings_scale)
585	    if scores != credential["public_output"]["quantized_scores"]:
586	        raise ZkError("credential public scores do not match the proven instances")
587	    if label != credential["public_output"]["label"]:
588	        raise ZkError("credential label does not match the proven instances")
589	
590	    return {"verified": True, "model_sha256": model_sha,
591	            "quantized_scores": scores, "scores_fixed_point": fixed_point, "label": label}
